metadata.question: Was the nighttime brightness over Wolf Volcano on Isabela Island brighter on January 7, 2022 then January 6 2022?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use NASA Black Marble daily nightlights (NASA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A2), band DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL. Compare Jan 6 vs Jan 7, 2022 over a buffered point at Wolf Volcano (approx -91.35, 0.02). Filter by date [day, day+1) and bounds, mosaic tiles if multiple.
2. Masking strategy: Do not apply additional masking to avoid band/QA misinterpretation and ensure valid pixels remain. We validate by counting unmasked pixels in the band.
3. Logic for Valid Zero vs Null/Error: If collections are empty → C1. If after mosaicking, pixel count in region is 0 → C2. If mean is null/NaN/±Inf → C3. Otherwise compare means; if Jan 7 > Jan 6 → A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const wolfPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-91.35, 0.02]);
    const region = wolfPoint.buffer(4000).bounds(); // ~4 km buffer
    const scale = 1000;
    const band = 'DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL';
    const datasetId = 'NASA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A2';
    const day1 = '2022-01-06';
    const day2 = '2022-01-07';

    // 2. Helper to get stats for a specific date
    async function getDayStats(dateStr) {
      const start = ee.Date(dateStr);
      const end = start.advance(1, 'day');
      let col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId)
        .filterBounds(region)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .select([band]);

      const size = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (size === 0) {
        return { date: dateStr, size: 0, mean: null, count: 0, usedFallback: false };
      }
      const img = col.mosaic();
      const reducers = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true });
      const stats = await img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: reducers,
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).getInfo();

      const meanVal = stats ? stats[band + '_mean'] : null;
      const countVal = stats ? stats[band + '_count'] : 0;
      return { date: dateStr, size, mean: meanVal, count: countVal, usedFallback: false };
    }

    // 3. Data Acquisition & Check
    console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetId} | Band: ${band} | Scale: ${scale}m | Buffer_m: 4000`);

    const s1 = await getDayStats(day1);
    const s2 = await getDayStats(day2);

    // Check empty collections
    if (s1.size === 0 || s2.size === 0) {
      console.log(`${day1} Images: ${s1.size}`);
      console.log(`${day2} Images: ${s2.size}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Check no valid pixels after processing
    if ((s1.count || 0) === 0 || (s2.count || 0) === 0) {
      console.log(`${day1} Images: ${s1.size} | Pixels: ${s1.count}`);
      console.log(`${day2} Images: ${s2.size} | Pixels: ${s2.count}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation & Validation
    const v1 = s1.mean;
    const v2 = s2.mean;

    const valid1 = typeof v1 === 'number' && isFinite(v1);
    const valid2 = typeof v2 === 'number' && isFinite(v2);
    if (!valid1 || !valid2) {
      console.log(`${day1} Mean: ${v1} | Pixels: ${s1.count}`);
      console.log(`${day2} Mean: ${v2} | Pixels: ${s2.count}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Print concise evidence
    console.log(`${day1} Images: ${s1.size} | Mean: ${v1.toFixed(6)} | Pixels: ${s1.count}`);
    console.log(`${day2} Images: ${s2.size} | Mean: ${v2.toFixed(6)} | Pixels: ${s2.count}`);
    console.log(`Delta (Jan7 - Jan6): ${(v2 - v1).toFixed(6)}`);

    // 6. Final Answer
    // A: Yes (brighter on Jan 7), B: No (not brighter)
    if (v2 > v1) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // Any dataset/band/name/memory or runtime error
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
